claim: HBGD-derived growth information contains predictive signal
safe_statement: HBGD-derived features provide a modest incremental predictive contribution beyond geometry in the tested LUMIERE cohort.
Observed improvements did not consistently reach statistical significance.

claim: HBGD phenotype structure is transferable across cancers
safe_statement: Descriptive phenotype similarities were observed, but statistical alignment was not established.

claim: Simple growth-rate normalization transfers across cancers
safe_statement: Simple source-to-target rate normalization did not outperform the target geometry baseline.
The tested domain-adaptation strategy improved direct transfer but did not outperform geometry.
A source-derived HBGD representation produced a directional improvement beyond geometry on the held-out LUMIERE cohort.

claim: Cross-cancer HBGD transfer is clinically validated
safe_statement: The current evidence is exploratory and requires larger independent longitudinal cohorts.
